name: Drink the Ocean
description: Drink the Ocean (Mana) player guide: straw upgrades, bladder and flush, treasure tools, co-op and the route from the starting island to Midnight Sea.

faq.question: Where can I play Drink the Ocean for free?
faq.answer: Play the Mana version at https://mana.gs/drink-the-ocean on a desktop browser. Select Play Now; it does not require a download or account. This guide is independent and links to the official game rather than hosting it.

faq.question: Is Drink the Ocean on Steam, or do I need to download it?
faq.answer: The verified Mana edition runs in a desktop browser. Mana does not list a Steam release or installer for this version. Beware of similarly named games on other platforms with different mechanics.

faq.question: How do you play Drink the Ocean with friends in multiplayer?
faq.answer: The main menu has MULTIPLAYER and Mana lists 1–4 player co-op. In Dr_Horse's co-op recording, a joining player discusses entering the session name and room number. Follow the current prompts in your game; lobby labels can change.

faq.question: Can you play Drink the Ocean on mobile, and what are the controls?
faq.answer: Mana lists desktop browsers with keyboard and mouse. The official listing does not provide a complete hotkey chart; check the in-game prompts. In Malakye G's Mana gameplay the Sponge Bomb tool displays the F key after purchase. This does not establish every key or mobile support.

faq.question: Does Drink the Ocean save your progress across devices?
faq.answer: Mana says game progress is stored locally in the current browser, and signing in does not currently sync saves across devices. Avoid clearing the browser's site data if you want to keep that local progress.

faq.question: Why is Drink the Ocean loading slowly or lagging?
faq.answer: The first load can take time because it runs a large browser game. Use a current desktop browser with hardware acceleration, and try reducing graphics settings or closing heavy tabs. In his full playthrough, Juste une run reports FPS drops when recording and playing at the same time; performance will vary by computer.

faq.question: Should I save for the next straw or upgrade suction power first?
faq.answer: There is no verified fastest upgrade order. Jayify and Dr_Horse each debate saving money for a higher-tier straw versus buying immediate suction, diameter or range improvements. If the next straw is affordable soon, compare its displayed multiplier to your available smaller upgrades; otherwise keep selling newly exposed treasure.

faq.question: Why does my bladder fill so fast, and how do I empty it faster?
faq.answer: The bladder gauge fills while you drink; when full, head to an outhouse to empty it. Iron Bladder increases capacity and Quick Flush reduces time spent emptying. Both were visible in Mana-version playthroughs. Plan merchant and outhouse visits together to cut extra walking.

faq.question: How do I unlock the next ocean, Lost Lagoon and Midnight Sea?
faq.answer: Keep draining and exploring until a gate/portal appears. Jayify enters the first portal into Lost Lagoon, then a later portal into Midnight Sea. The game warns about not returning when entering certain gates, so collect wanted items before proceeding. Exact universal water-level thresholds are not verified.

faq.question: What happens at 100%? Why haven't I bought every upgrade, and can I enter the last gate?
faq.answer: Jayify's 100% run ends with a completion message for the island, lagoon and Midnight Sea, while upgrades remain unpurchased; he cannot enter the final structure he tries. Dr_Horse also notes that reaching 100% before trying every upgrade feels unsatisfying. Don't assume that 100% means maxing every item or that an additional playable zone is available.
